purpose: NLM-005 (locked a12aad4 + artifact lock aab0f69): composed substitution/transport with hflip and shift1px re-encoded transports, true fine-label endpoint
notes: VOID by kill condition 3 (support 32% < 80%). Hflip is non-diagnostic by the <0.02 order-gap condition; shift1px chart gaps are also below 0.02, but R_no_coarse is 0.027 on that sensitivity row. Substantively, cosine leads native candidates by about 0.32 on every order. Design flaw: hflip and 1-px shift are augmentations DINOv2 was trained to be invariant to, so these transports are near-identity in its world; and 40 random candidates over 100 classes cannot reach 80% support without stratified sampling. Next transports must lie outside the encoder's trained invariance class.
